jobs.name: v3_mom_call
jobs.instructions: A Korean woman in her late fifties answering her phone at 3:33 a.m. at a dark kitchen table, holding it to her ear. For a whole year she has called her missing daughter every night and no one ever answered; this time the call came from her daughter. Plain standard Korean with a low, warm, slightly hoarse voice; no regional accent, nothing exaggerated. First '여보세요?' — careful and very quiet, almost afraid to break something. About one second of silence. '…세아야?' — almost only breath, a little higher, fragile hope. About one second of silence. '세아야, 엄마야.' — warm and trembling, holding back tears, slower on '엄마야'. No crying, no sobbing, no laugh, no gasp, no theatrical emotion. End with a soft, unsteady breath. Say the name 세아 as two clean syllables 'se-a'.
jobs.layout_note: file t = recording r - 0.6: lead 0.4 s, phrases at r 1.0 / 3.0 / 5.0-6.6, end breath r 6.6-7.4 (§7.3); dry - the room (irLiving .5) and the phone-mic chain are runtime

jobs.name: v3_mom_okay
jobs.instructions: The same Korean woman in her late fifties, at dawn, standing at her gas stove just after lighting it, her back to the dining table. She speaks quietly, half to the young guest sitting at the table behind her and half to herself. '괜찮대요.' — quiet and certain, a held breath released. A short pause. '우리 딸이 괜찮대요.' — slower and warmer, a small smile breaking through held-back tears on '우리 딸이', as if she has decided to believe it; relief, not triumph. Not crying, no sobbing, no laugh, no drama. Same voice and intonation as before, low and steady at the very end.

jobs.name: v3_sea_name
jobs.instructions: A frightened young Korean woman in her twenties whispering very quietly into a phone microphone at night so that someone nearby cannot hear — trembling, breathy, intimate. She hides a single name between two quiet breaths inside her humming: '하루야' (ha-ru-ya). Pure whisper, no voiced tone, no pitch; about 0.6 seconds, the last syllable fading out, a small breath before and after. Secret and tender, not loud.
